cpContext.rule: Assign only when the source sentence explicitly states that drawing an SSR simultaneously grants CP points usable in a named activity.
cpContext.evidencePattern: 抽取到SSR英雄时 ... 在「<event label>」活动中可以使用的「CP点」

eventReference.source: the event label captured from the same explicit CP sentence
eventReference.rule: Preserve the source event label as text evidence. Do not join Event ConfigData by display-name equality.

occurrenceProjection.rule: Every canonical occurrence whose bannerDefinitionId is CP_RELATED receives a derived CP_RELATED projection without changing occurrence identity or lifecycle.

prohibited: creating a canonical event ID from the source label
CP inference from bannerCode or asset filename
CP inference from Korean terminology alone
using arbitrary quoted labels as Event identity
changing Stage 2-4 taxonomy or Stage 2-5 Hero relations
